# Zaher Karp

> Manager of Data Science & Engineering at Baltimore Health Analytics. Healthcare data engineering and Medicare Advantage analytics, built around CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS pipelines, and regulatory translation between CMS Technical Notes and production code.

## About

[Personal homepage](https://zaherkarp.com/) covers the full career arc, current role, projects, publications, speaking, and education. The About section narrates the path from research to data engineering. The career arc figure summarizes employers from 2007 to present.

## Writing

[Blog index (/blog/)](https://zaherkarp.com/blog/) collects long-form writing on healthcare data engineering, Medicare Advantage Stars methodology, and adjacent topics.

The pre-2019 [archive (/blog/archive/)](https://zaherkarp.com/blog/archive/) preserves earlier writing on sustainability, education, and policy. URLs from the archive remain stable.

[RSS feed (/blog/feed.xml)](https://zaherkarp.com/blog/feed.xml) for subscribers and aggregators.

## Projects

Six projects on the homepage, numbered by DOM order: the Medicare Advantage Insight Engine opens the page as project 01, the Stars Cliff Simulator is featured second, and four more sit in a "More projects" fold.

- Medicare Advantage Insight Engine, a live feed at https://zaherkarp.com/medicare-advantage-insight-engine/ (served by a separate zaherkarp/medicare-advantage-insight-engine repo's own GitHub Pages, under the shared zaherkarp.com domain). Methodology at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/medicare-advantage-insight-engine/.
- [Stars Cliff Simulator (/star-rating-predictor/)](https://zaherkarp.com/star-rating-predictor/), a public teaching demo focused on the 4.0★ QBP cliff. Methodology at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/star-rating-demo-methodology/.
- Healthcare Workforce Transition Platform, also called SkillSprout (github.com/zaherkarp/skillsprout), a career trajectory explorer that ranks O*NET 28.3 occupations against a freeform skill query. The hosted subpage was retired; write-up at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/onet-reskilling-probabilities/.
- ECDS Shock Index, at github.com/zaherkarp/ecds-shock-index. Write-up at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/ecds-shock-index/.
- Care Delivery Workflow Changes. Visual case study at https://zaherkarp.com/case-study-care-redesign/, write-up at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/interrupted-time-series-care-redesign/.
- Practice Automation Analytics, healthfinch Charlie. Write-up at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/practice-automation-workflow-roi/.

Two more interactive subpages exist but are not homepage project cards:

- [Life in Weeks (/life-in-weeks/)](https://zaherkarp.com/life-in-weeks/), a 90-year weekly grid in the Tim Urban tradition.
- [Epidemic simulation (/epidemic-simulation/)](https://zaherkarp.com/epidemic-simulation/), a browser-side stochastic SEIRV simulator. Methodology at https://zaherkarp.com/blog/two-states-one-pathogen/.

## Colophon

[Colophon (/colophon/)](https://zaherkarp.com/colophon/) explains how the site is built: no framework, five Python build pipelines, twelve linters and a pre-push hook. Linked from every page footer.

## Resume and CV

[Resume PDF (/resume.pdf)](https://zaherkarp.com/resume.pdf), generated from a markdown source; the build is path-filtered to pushes touching the resume source, publications data, skills data, or the build script, not every push to the repo.

[CV (/cv.html)](https://zaherkarp.com/cv.html), a traditional academic curriculum vitae built from the same pipeline: education, appointments, publications, presentations, and academic service.
